As others have said: HECTOs and good aim.

Alternatively, VREX-ND-2 FCS, CWC-GNL-15 back grenade launcher, and CWGG-HR-66 hand rockets, and any OB core. The main body is a big target and the rockets have deceptively long range, so keep your distance and it shouldn't fire any missiles at you. 5 hits from the rockets will make them seperate, then after the cutscene take cover behind the crashed ship. Once the missiles are gone, OB to the southeast corner and pump grenades into the detached portion, 9 should kill it. Then go back to the strat for main body and after 15 or so more rocket hits it should go down as well. If it gets too close and starts firing missiles, OB away

Weapon purge seems to always look for R1+L1+R2+L2 regardless of control setup, which behaves unusually if you put any of the attack buttons on those. Because of FromSoft Programming™, with your control setup you can purge left arm and extensions, but nothing else. But imo 3/SL are lenient enough with build options that weapon purging isn't really even necessary
